was a patient of Riverside Medical Practice for five years. In all honesty, this was the worst medical practice I ever came across. I believe that Riverfront Medical failed in their duty of care for me. The practice has over 9000 patients, it is overwhelmed and effective due to large patient numbers.

With that said, my GP was the best doctor I ever had and the practice nurse was amazing! The medical staff are very good. The issues are with the way the practice is managed. The practice manager, senior medical partners and  receptionists let this practice down.

A few days after I joined Riverfront, I was the victim of a serious data protection breach. Royal Mail posted me an envelope containing my personal details and the personal information of a number of other patients. The admin staff had failed to pay the correct postage when forwarding this information to Medical Support Services. I just happend to be the first person at the top of pile and Royal Mail posted me everyone's information. I reported this to the practice manager, she promised to get back to me, however that was the last I heard of the matter. At the time, I should have made an official complaint, I was afraid to complain because everyone is afraid to complain about their doctor. This is why practices like this get away with errors and are not held to account.

When calling in the morning for an appointment, the telephone lines are usually engaged from 8.30am onwards. When I eventually got to speak to a member of staff, normally I was advised to ring again the next day because there were no appointments. Patients deserve be treated better than this!

On one occasion, I was told to ring back the next morning, I was running a very high temperature. It was only when I called A & E and they instructed me to come to the hospital. Only then, was l allowed to see a doctor. I had a very bad infection, that moved into my bloodstream and was beginning to attack my heart. I was sent straight to hospital where I spent a week  on IV antibiotics. I was told I was very lucky! I should not have been allowed to get so sick when antibiotics are available. It happened because I wasn't able to access a doctor.

Some of the receptionists  were very unhelpful, abrupt and  rude. For some staff, anything asked of them seemed to be too much bother. Their usual response was  "ring again tomorrow" or outright refuse to help. Some of the new receptionist seem to be more helpful. The issue is with staff who have worked at the practice for a long time and have got into a rut.

Things were not delt with in a timely manner, there were errors made with post and emails. Letters forwarded to the practice by other medical professionals were never answered.

I had a tremendous amount of respect for my GP, who was extremely professional and empathetic. Sometimes l wondered if information was passed on correctly or even give to my GP.

Perhaps, if the practice manger had run a tighter ship much of these issues and mistakes could have been avoided. Often sloppy and poor work is a result of poor management. I stayed because I didn't want to lose a great GP who I really respected.

When I did make my thoughts known to the practice manager about their failure to provide an adequate duty of care, they told me "perhaps a new start with another practice would do you good". The practice manager failed to acknowledge that the practice was at fault. I found them dogmatic and explained away all my concerns and issues. Patients should not be treated like this, they have rights. When I tried to make my concerns know I was put in my place and felt browbeaten.

I hope I have left an honest and measured review. There is no point having a great GP if you can never access them.

People should complain and not accept treatment like this! I added a picture of an empty waiting room, when you look at this, I wonder why patients get an appointment in this practice to see a doctor; it is disgraceful!

My new practice is friendly, accessible and professional and not at all like Riverfront!",null,[0,231]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURibU5TakJBEAE!2m1!1s0x0:0x4edf67565b9a0c67!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgIDbmNSjBA%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURibU5TakJBEAE&t=1&entityid=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURibU5TakJBEi4KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJRGJtTlNqaEFFEhNDZ3dJd0pUNnRRWVFpTmk2Z0FFGi0KFkNJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJRGJtTlNqUkESE0Nnd0lqcUN2dFFZUXVLam51Z0UiEgkAAAAAAAAAABFnDJpbVmffTioTQ2d3SXdKVDZ0UVlRaU5pNmdBRQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiAs7HPo7aTAxWtAGMBHfYMMmkQoykIHigC"],null,[null,[[1,7]]]],"0ahUKEwiAs7HPo7aTAxWtAGMBHfYMMmkQ0pMFCBooCA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFDUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSelp1YzE5VWVWOWZSV2hFU0hoMk1XNUdiazlYTjJ0WWRFZElPRUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpXVVVOaWNXVjZPVkJKV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNUOUltU1ZnEAE",["0x0:0x4edf67565b9a0c67",null,1715445925578405,1715446455215446,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/102322031590568697493/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["angelina","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXY_LIljppafY2zQaPd5TVeTGVkq6D9RATU3GIaMT6q1QU1Cs3E=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/102322031590568697493?hl=en"],"102322031590568697493",null,1,0,null,[0,2,1],2,["1 review",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiAs7HPo7aTAxWtAGMBHfYMMmkQ7LoGCCAoAA"]]]],null,"a year ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Lovely staff!!
